overall_worst.defect: The At the till docs screenshots are drawn at three different widths and in three different frame styles (full width, ~380 px card, ~510 px card), with about 70 px of extra top whitespace on the last two, so the page has no consistent figure rhythm.
overall_worst.fix: Give every docs screenshot one figure component: the same max-width (or full content width with phone-shaped shots centred inside a fixed frame), the same border, radius and caption alignment, and the standard paragraph-to-figure top margin.
